maddeler.e:
اختزلن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَزَلْنَ (iḵtazalna) /ix.ta.zal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# اُخْتُزِلْنَ (uḵtuzilna) /ux.tu.zil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# اِخْتَزِلْنَ (iḵtazilna) /ix.ta.zil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
